facts.statement: The study used male mice to show that a specific group of brain cells called arcuate Kiss1 neurons helps control heat production in brown fat.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: When these neurons were removed, the mice gained weight, but when they were artificially turned on, the mice burned more heat without eating more.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The heat production was driven by signals sent from the arcuate neurons to a specific area in the brain called the dorsomedial hypothalamus.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Using a gene-editing tool to remove a gene that makes a specific chemical messenger in these neurons caused the same weight gain as removing the neurons entirely.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Removing a specific receptor gene from the Kiss1 neurons led to obesity because it changed how the body balances energy.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Using light to stimulate certain brain fibers showed that the Kiss1 neurons respond to signals through the melanocortin 4 receptor.
facts.subject: animals
